messages:
elena_security: Sam (auditor) asked for SOC2 evidence: 30d RBAC change log, KMS decrypt proof showing HSM protection, IAM snapshot at decrypt time, and a replayable bundle without live creds. Meeting Thu 2pm PT.

morgan_eng: Plan -> generate replay bundle with presigned S3 objects: k8s rolebinding diffs, CloudAudit log entries for CryptokeyDecrypted, key metadata, IAM snapshot, and verify script that checks sha256 + signatures. No live creds.

auditor_sam: Need decrypt event with timestamp, key id+version, protectionLevel, and an approval record for any JIT elevation used. If transcript can't be exported, include compensating controls and ticket ref.

jenna_ops: Will stage artifacts to s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-04-01-jit-replay/. Presigned links TTL=7d. Internal retention 90d. Will redact PII.

morgan_eng: Example verify output included: 
$ gcloud kms keys versions describe 5 --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/service-prod
protectionLevel: HSM
state: ENABLED
createTime: "2025-08-02T14:12:03Z"

elena_security: Add a short sampling rationale: risk-based window (rotation + admin spike) and a CSV index of included objects + hash list. Also include a redaction map.

morgan_eng: Added mitigation note for scanner finding (legacy user binding): revoke legacy binding, rotate to new key version, add detection rule for nonapproved principals. Include commands and TODO for automation.

auditor_sam: Good. Also want the IAM policy snapshot for the principal that performed decrypt (redacted if necessary). Ticket ref for JIT = INF-3421.

jenna_ops: Bundle uploaded. deploy-bot: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-04-01-jit-replay/bundle.tar.gz (presigned link expires in 7 days). Manifest at s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-04-01-jit-replay/manifest.json sha256:abc123...

auditor_sam: Received. If I need a live playback we'll schedule a recorded window with you on call. Thanks :+1:
